Ask her these three specific things:</p><ol start="1" data-path-to-node="4"><li><p data-path-to-node="4,0,0"><b data-path-to-node="4,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">The "Dopamine Menu":</b> Ask her what her "low-effort/high-reward" tasks are.
